UK Services

What We Deliver in the UK

Every UK project receives the same structured documentation package as our North American work — navigable digital twin, narrated video walkthrough, written conditions report, equipment and asset schedule, labelled photo storyboard, and ScopeWalk platform access. Where survey-grade accuracy is required — and for heritage, conservation, and listed building work it usually is — we capture using professional LiDAR instrumentation producing millimetre-accurate point cloud data.

Heritage Building Survey

Pre-intervention documentation for Grade I and Grade II listed buildings, scheduled monuments, conservation areas, and significant private estates. Survey-grade point cloud data and structured records for English Heritage, Historic Scotland, Cadw, and conservation architects.

Learn more →

Pre-Construction Survey

Existing conditions documentation before fit-out, refurbishment, or change of use begins. Navigable digital twin, conditions report, above-ceiling MEP capture, and asset schedule — delivered before a design decision is made.

Learn more →

Measured Building Survey

Survey-grade point cloud data for architects and engineers requiring dimensional accuracy for CAD and Revit workflows. Accurate to 5–12mm across full building footprints. Exports in .e57 and .rcp format.

Learn more →

Above-Ceiling MEP Survey

Thermal imaging, 360° pole-mounted capture, and borescope inspection to document what's above the ceiling tile before fit-out begins. Non-invasive. Integrated into the full documentation package.

Learn more →

Multi-Site Rollout Survey

Consistent site documentation across distributed UK retail, QSR, and hospitality programmes. One brief, one format, one point of contact — from first site to last.

Learn more →

Coverage

Where We Work in the UK

We operate across all four nations — England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland — with no location surcharge for travel within the UK. Every project is quoted all-in.

Our UK work spans commercial and industrial property across London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Bristol, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Cardiff, and Belfast, as well as rural estates, heritage properties, and specialist sites outside the main commercial centres.

Heritage & Listed Buildings

Particular Strength in Heritage and Listed Building Work

In the UK, our most distinctive capability is heritage documentation. Our principal's background includes hands-on construction and conservation experience on some of Britain's most significant historic properties — Grade I and Grade II listed buildings, scheduled monuments, and properties under the stewardship of English Heritage, Historic Scotland, and Cadw.

We understand materials, construction methods, and what conservation architects and heritage bodies actually need from a survey record. We produce documentation that serves the planning process, not just the project team.
